Dear Surojit Dutta,

Learning new skills is a fundamental part of life. By combining these skills, we can leverage new strengths to advance our careers, land interviews, and strengthen our connections with others. We’ve brought together some of our highest-rated courses that offer the opportunity to combine interconnected skills with your current expertise — to help you get to where you want to be in your career and in life. 

For learners who have already completed a course in the series, your completion counts towards a full Specialization certificate.

------------------------------------------

Navigate the AI-Era with Confidence 

Enhance your critical thinking, business innovation, and leadership skills with AI Literacy for Everybody. Discover how AI tools work and learn practical, responsible ways to integrate them into your daily workflow to save time and boost productivity.

Learn the AI essentials.

------------------------------------------

Lead from any Position

True leadership isn't about a title, it's about connection. Master the psychology of persuasion, build cross-functional trust, and learn how to rally teams around your ideas, no matter your role, with Influencing People without Authority.

Grow your workplace influence.

------------------------------------------

Explore Essential Logic Frameworks 

Critical Thinking and Decision Science provides you with the frameworks needed to make better decisions. The Specialization combines model thinking, computational problem-solving, evidence-based reasoning, and practical AI prompting to build your confidence, evaluate risk more effectively, and make high-stakes decisions. 

Sharpen your critical thinking.

------------------------------------------

Drive Meaningful Community Change

Advocate for systemic progress with Social Impact & Public Policy. Learn how to shape policy from both local and national perspectives, drawing on multiple perspectives that can help drive positive social change. 

Explore pathways for social impact. 

------------------------------------------

Invest in You

It’s all in the title: Personal and Professional Development gives you the essential skills, resilience tactics, and career-mapping strategies needed to navigate today’s job market and achieve career milestones that matter to you.  

Accelerate your personal and professional growth.

------------------------------------------
